evidence_quotes: As a platform aggregating 20+ AI models for video generation, A2E.AI faces significant technical challenges.

Running multiple inference models — video synthesis, face swapping, voice cloning, lip-sync, and image generation — simultaneously demands massive accelerated computing power with elastic scaling to handle unpredictable traffic spikes.

Supplying a Global Customer Base: Serving an international user base across North America, East Asia, the Middle East, and Europe necessitated a low-latency delivery and strict data residency compliance, including GDPR.
Maintenance and Monitoring: A2E.AI required 24/7 monitoring and continuous high availability in order to maintain its target SLA of 99.6%.
